scheduler_contract.preemption: cooperative only at one fake browser request or one fake image OCR boundary
scheduler_contract.fairness: task-category base priority plus monotonic waiting-time aging; rotate after every contested atomic unit
scheduler_contract.resource_order: never hold platform_browser while waiting for OCR and never hold OCR while waiting for platform_browser
scheduler_contract.waiting_user: holds no browser or OCR lease
scheduler_contract.pause: stop new WorkItems, finish current atomic unit, checkpoint, release owned automatic leases, then pause
scheduler_contract.resume: reuse the same Job, frozen fixture, and latest checkpoint without repeating completed download stages
scheduler_contract.cancel: preserve committed results, cancel unfinished items with end_reason=not_processed when never started, and do not stop shared work still needed by another Job

acceptance: A fake loading-detail probe can acquire platform_browser while an audit item holds gpu_ocr_slot
Pause releases the audit GPU lease after its current image and resume does not repeat a completed download
Pause followed by cancel ends safely without losing committed results
Cancelling one consumer does not stop another Job or shared evidence work
Suspected swapped and numeric mismatch items wait for a person while normal items continue
The same image and pipeline fingerprint produce one OCR StageAttempt
A duplicate active audit ConflictKey does not create a competing Job
Three visible Jobs retain independent controls and selection context
Long and short Jobs rotate under contention without deadlock or starvation
Every wait exposes a resource, dependency, or user reason
